summary: Audited the current web and Flutter screen-thumbnail implementations against ADR-013. Both clients capture bounded JPEG previews from LiveKit screen-video tracks without DataPackets; temporary hidden-preview subscriptions are serialized, selected-viewer subscriptions are retained, and lifecycle/race regressions are covered. Focused web and Flutter tests plus web production build and Flutter analyzer pass. Device/paired runtime acceptance and Windows runtime remain open.

checks.name: Web thumbnail capture/subscription regressions
checks.observation: All 13 focused tests pass, covering JPEG validation, remote frame capture and the serialized temporary subscription/viewer-selection lifecycle.

checks.name: Web production typecheck and build
checks.observation: vue-tsc and Vite build pass; Vite reports its existing advisory for chunks larger than 500 kB.

checks.name: Flutter thumbnail pipeline/widget regressions
checks.command: cd desktop && flutter test --no-pub test/screen_thumbnail_pipeline_test.dart test/screen_thumbnail_test.dart test/voice_participant_thumbnail_test.dart
checks.observation: All 20 focused tests pass, covering decoded-frame gating, bounded capture, native capture serialization, temporary subscription cleanup, selected-viewer retention, stale selections and participant-card rendering.

checks.name: Paired Android-to-macOS/web runtime acceptance
checks.observation: ADB was unavailable in this session. No voice connection or screen projection was started; remote thumbnail delivery, unpublish cleanup and live bandwidth were not observed.

checks.name: Windows screen-thumbnail runtime acceptance
checks.observation: No Windows runtime was available in this session.

remaining: Run an explicitly authorized paired Android-to-macOS/web preview and verify appearance, retention until unpublish, cleanup, selected-viewer playback and voice continuity; separately exercise the Windows runtime. Keep ADR-013 acceptance open until those observations are recorded.
